issues.description: Aufgabe 01 in the problem statement requires the names and internet addresses (url) of all Zoos and the name and Regierungsbezirk of the respective Gemeinde. The solution (solution_repository/aufgabe01.sql) only selects Zoo.name and Zoo.url and omits Gemeinde.name and Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk, so it does not produce the columns the task requests. The template (template_repository/aufgabe01.sql) also does not include Zoo.url or Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk and lacks an explicit join condition; while starter code can be incomplete by design, the solution's omission of the Gemeinde columns is a cross-artifact mismatch: the reference solution does not implement the specified output, which will confuse students and/or make automatic checks fail.
issues.suggested_fix: Update the reference solution to select exactly the columns requested by the problem: include Gemeinde.name and Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk in the SELECT list and keep the proper join. For example: SELECT Zoo.name, Zoo.url AS Internetadresse, Gemeinde.name AS Gemeinde_name, Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk FROM Zoo JOIN Gemeinde ON Zoo.gemeindeschluessel = Gemeinde.schluessel; Additionally, adjust the template (template_repository/aufgabe01.sql) to show the intended output columns (or a clear placeholder) and include the join condition as a hint so students are not misled by an incomplete starter that suggests a different result schema.
